card_text_anchors.pumpkaboo: Pumpkaboo swsh7-76 / Pumpkin Pit: when played from hand onto the Bench, it may discard a Stadium in play.
card_text_anchors.chien_pao: Chien-Pao sv8-56 / Snow Sink has the same relevant hand-to-Bench Stadium-discard geometry.
card_text_anchors.sky_field: Sky Field xy6-89 lets each player have 8 Benched Pokémon while it is in play.
card_text_anchors.area_zero: Area Zero Underdepths sv7-131: a player with a Tera Pokémon in play can have up to 8 Benched Pokémon; otherwise the expansion does not apply.
card_text_anchors.collapsed: Collapsed Stadium swsh9-137/swsh11-215 restricts each player to 4 Benched Pokémon.

pumpkaboo_with_one_slack: Bench Pumpkin Pit remover and discard Stadium

findings.bootstrap_threshold: a Bench-triggered Stadium remover cannot unlock a full restricted Bench because it must enter the Bench before its removal Ability can resolve
findings.cross_channel_tradeoff: direct Stadium replacement can restore capacity from zero slack because it spends Stadium bandwidth rather than Bench slack
findings.conditional_expansion_order: after Area Zero replaces a restriction with no Tera in play, the first reopened default slot must be used by a Tera before additional entrants can exploit capacity 8
